what_was_done: The lock refresh and the session-end release are core duties of the hook runner, wired with no rule beside the caller-marker duty: liveness.refresh on every PreToolUse call and liveness.release on SessionEnd, calling records' lock_seen and lock_release. Lock liveness no longer waits for H9, so no workflow of the slice holds a lock that goes stale after 20 minutes while it runs.

The refresh goes by the run the call names and the story it works in, not by the session id alone: liveness.refresh passes the --run value of a vsdd segment, tool_input.step.run of a StructOutput call, and ctx.story of the call's worktree to lock_seen, which decides belonging. Steps that start in the main session's directory are covered by step.run and by the story worktree they are given by path.
where: next/plugins/vsdd-factory/py/vsdd/hooks/liveness.py (run_of); tests/hooks/test_liveness.py (test_lock_refresh: the --run, the step.run and the story-worktree cases)

what_was_done: The refresh half: runs with no worktree of their own are kept alive by the StructuredOutput step.run refresh and the vsdd --run refresh (test_lock_refresh). The clear half stays with the probe, not with this fix: SessionEnd releases whatever the reason (liveness.release reads the reason only to log it), and whether a workflow survives /clear is still unproven after round 4, which tested SIGTERM, not a clear — if a probe shows one surviving, keeping the lock on reason clear is a one-line change; until then a workflow that survives has its run ended and its next gate refuses run_not_live out loud. The clear half is left for B8 (the probe), then H9.
